dedupe_keys.name: bdappv aerial photovoltaic imagery and annotations

description: Mines Paris PSL, RTE, BDPV and LuciSun contributors publish BDAPPV to support mapping distributed photovoltaic installations from overhead imagery. The deposit includes image and mask packages, installation metadata, raw crowd annotations and replication tables in CSV and JSON. It reports metadata for over 28,000 installations and masks for about 13,000, with thousands imaged by both Google and the French IGN. Coverage consists of these static campaigns and BDPV-linked installations; a uniform imagery date or complete national census is not claimed. Downloads are free, with general CC BY 4.0 metadata, separate Google imagery terms and IGN Open Licence 2.0. The benchmark can train asset-mapping steps used in grid-capacity and exposure simulations, complementing data-harmonised-global-wind-solar-farm-locations-osm. A caveat is that crowd annotations, metadata matching and image-provider differences affect detection quality. The general deposit licence does not erase the image-source terms. No images or annotations were downloaded or inspected individually.
